note: Shop welcome kit: bilingual printable QR banner + welcome e-mail on go-live (docs/shop-welcome-kit-2026-11, PR #431), written 20-Nov-2026 against the code on feature/shop-welcome-kit-banner. Added to test-cases.xlsx / tests/qa/catalog by scripts/qa/plan_workbook.py add-json.

features.feature: Shop welcome kit: every live shop's own QR code (/shops/<slug>), the owner's banner design filled with the shop's name and QR in English + the local language (Marathi for Maharashtra / Goa, Hindi elsewhere), e-mailed once when the shop goes live (all approval paths), downloadable again from Seller Central → Marketing, and an admin-only 'Send welcome kit' for shops live before it (feature flag, off by default)

scenarios.title: A new shop gets its printable QR banners the moment it goes live
scenarios.description: When a shop goes live (paid self-registration, admin / operator approval, automatic or instant GST/PAN approval) the owner is e-mailed once: congratulations, both banners shown and attached as A4 PDFs, and clear print instructions. The owner and operations can download them again from Seller Central; customers who scan the QR land on the shop's own page.

cases.title: Approving a shop queues the welcome e-mail once, and it is sent
cases.preconditions: A registered shop with its documents verified and the fee paid; the owner has a real e-mail address; e-mail delivery configured (local: the mail catcher).
cases.steps:
1. As operations, POST /api/shops/<id>/approve
2. Read document_emails for doc_type SHOP_WELCOME_KIT and the shop
3. Wait for the outbox to send it; read the owner's mailbox
cases.expected: Exactly one SHOP_WELCOME_KIT row for the shop, addressed to the owner, subject 'Congratulations! <shop> is now live on GoKesari'. It is sent within a minute (status SENT). The approval is never blocked by it.

cases.title: Self-registration: the welcome e-mail follows the fee payment
cases.preconditions: PAYMENT_GATEWAY=SANDBOX (test.gokesari.com / local). A fresh owner with a real e-mail address.
cases.steps:
1. Register a shop in the wizard (GSTIN or PAN verified, address and map pin, shop details)
2. Pay the registration fee on /orders/pay/sandbox/… → 'Pay (success)'
3. Wait for the shop to go live
4. Read document_emails and the owner's mailbox
cases.expected: The shop goes live and exactly one welcome e-mail is queued and sent to the owner, with the English banner and the local-language banner (Marathi for a Pune shop).

cases.title: A shop is welcomed once, ever
cases.preconditions: A live shop that already had the welcome e-mail.
cases.steps:
1. Suspend the shop and approve it again (or hand it to another owner and approve)
2. Read document_emails for the shop
cases.expected: Still exactly one SHOP_WELCOME_KIT row for the shop; no second e-mail.

cases.title: The welcome e-mail shows both banners, attaches both PDFs and gives the print instructions
cases.preconditions: The welcome e-mail of TC-WKIT-001 or TC-WKIT-002.
cases.steps:
1. Open the e-mail
2. Look at the images, the attachments and the text
cases.expected: Congratulations and welcome to GoKesari; both banners (English + local language) shown in the mail and attached as A4 landscape PDFs (GoKesari-banner-en-<slug>.pdf, GoKesari-banner-<mr|hi>-<slug>.pdf); instructions: print in COLOUR on a colour page (not black and white); A4 landscape 'Fit to page', or a sticker / flex from a print shop; scan the QR with a phone before putting it up; counter or entrance at eye level, laminated; tell customers 'Scan this to order from our shop on GoKesari'; one line in the local language; links to add products, Seller Central → Marketing and Help.

cases.title: Seller Central → Marketing: download both banners as PDF and PNG (desktop and phone)
cases.preconditions: A live (approved) shop's owner signed in.
cases.steps:
1. Open /shop/marketing on a desktop and on a phone
2. Find 'Your shop banner with QR code'
3. Press 'English banner (PDF)', then the local-language PDF and the two PNG buttons
cases.expected: The card shows four buttons: English banner (PDF), <Marathi|Hindi> banner (PDF), English (PNG), <Marathi|Hindi> (PNG). Each downloads the file (GoKesari-banner-<lang>-<slug>.pdf / .png). No sideways scroll on the phone. A shop not live yet shows no card.

cases.title: Banner download: owner and operations only (another owner 403, signed out 401)
cases.preconditions: A live shop A; another shop owner B; a customer; an operator.
cases.steps:
1. GET /api/shops/<A>/banner signed out
2. … as owner B, and as a customer
3. … as A's owner (?lang=en / local, &format=pdf / png)
4. … as an operator
cases.expected: Signed out 401; another owner 403; a customer 403; A's owner 200 (application/pdf or image/png, attachment GoKesari-banner-<lang>-<slug>.<ext>); operator 200. A shop not live yet answers 409.

cases.title: The banner's QR code opens the shop's own page on this site
cases.steps:
1. Download the PNG banner (English and local)
2. Decode the QR code in the 'Scan QR Code of Your Shop' box
3. Open the decoded link
cases.expected: Both QR codes hold <site>/shops/<slug> (test.gokesari.com on staging, gokesari.com on production) and the page shows the shop.

cases.title: Local language: Marathi in Maharashtra / Goa, Hindi elsewhere
cases.preconditions: Live shops in Pune (Maharashtra) and outside Maharashtra (e.g. Madhya Pradesh); one with no state and a PIN 40xxxx–44xxxx.
cases.steps:
1. Download ?lang=local for each shop
2. Read the file name and look at the banner
cases.expected: Maharashtra / Goa shops (or no state and PIN 40–44): Marathi (GoKesari-banner-mr-…); elsewhere: Hindi (GoKesari-banner-hi-…). The shop name prints as registered, Devanagari names shaped correctly; long names wrap onto two lines inside the box.

cases.title: Admin 'Send welcome kit' for shops live before it: off by default, admin only, once per shop
cases.preconditions: Live shops that never had the welcome kit; feature flag shop_welcome_kit_admin_send_enabled off.
cases.steps:
1. As admin, POST /api/admin/shops/welcome-kit {shopId} with the flag off
2. As operator / shop owner, GET and POST the same route
3. Turn the flag on; as admin send to one shop, then again
4. Preview a city (GET ?city=…&notWelcomed=1) and run the bulk send
5. Turn the flag off again
cases.expected: Flag off: 'This feature is not available' (404). Operator / owner: 403. Admin: the first send QUEUED and e-mailed, the second ALREADY_SENT (one row). The bulk run queues only live shops of that city that never had it (sent by the outbox sweep) and is audited. Existing live shops are never e-mailed without this action.

cases.title: Scanning the printed QR with a phone opens the shop (browser, and the app when installed)
cases.preconditions: A printed or on-screen banner; an Android phone and an iPhone, with and without the GoKesari app.
cases.steps:
1. Scan the English and the local-language QR with the phone camera
2. Repeat with the app installed
cases.expected: Without the app the shop's page opens in the browser. With the app the shop opens inside the app — once the association files carry the real Apple Team ID and Android signing fingerprint (docs/deep-links-activation.md); until then it opens in the browser.

cases.title: The PDF prints in colour on A4 landscape and stays readable and scannable
cases.steps:
1. Print both PDFs on A4, landscape, 'Fit to page', in colour
2. Scan the printed QR from 50 cm
cases.expected: The whole banner fits the page in the GoKesari colours, the name is sharp, the QR scans.

cases.title: A native speaker approves the Marathi and Hindi wording
cases.preconditions: The templates template-mr.png / template-hi.png and the e-mail's local line.
cases.steps: 1. A Marathi and a Hindi speaker read the two templates and LOCAL_PRINT_LINE (docs/shop-welcome-kit-2026-11/README.md lists every phrase)
cases.expected: Wording approved, or corrections sent and the generator re-run before production.

cases.title: Production: the first real go-live e-mail is SENT
cases.preconditions: The release on gokesari.com; the next shop that goes live.
cases.steps: 1. After a real shop goes live on gokesari.com, read document_emails (doc_type SHOP_WELCOME_KIT) for it
cases.expected: One row, status SENT, to the owner's address; no test payment made on production.

e2e.title: New shop → paid → live → welcome kit e-mail → banner downloaded again → QR opens the shop
e2e.journey:
1. A new owner registers a shop in the wizard and pays the fee (sandbox)
2. The shop goes live
3. The welcome e-mail arrives with both banners and print instructions
4. The owner downloads the banners from Seller Central → Marketing
5. The QR code on the banner opens the shop's page
e2e.expected: One welcome e-mail with the English and the local-language banner (PDFs attached); the Marketing downloads match; the QR opens <site>/shops/<slug>.
